out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. CDI: EHS provided paper copy written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: plastic squeeze bottle filled with sauce and bulk container of salt or sugar.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CDI: EHS discussed with CFM to label the plastic squeeze bottle filled with sauce and bulk container sugar or salt.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device (4-way splitter) on the mop sink in the back kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CDI: CFM removed 4-way splitter at the mop sink.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided via email the Spanish version of the employee health policy for staff to sign.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). EHS EMAILED THE EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY TO MANAGEMENT FOR SIGNATURES.

violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS EMAILED THE WRITTEN POLICY ON HOW TO CLEAN UP ANY EVENTS OF VOMITING AND/OR DIARRHEA.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation after coming in from outside.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS REMINDED MANAGEMENT THAT STAFF ARE REQUIRED TO CHANGE THEIR GLOVES AND WASH THEIR HANDS WHENEVER THEY CHANGE TASKS. STAFF WERE INSTRUCTED TO WASH HANDS AT HAND SINKS AS REQUIRED.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Observed the beverage dispensing nozzles not being cleaned as frequently as required.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO TRAIN STAFF TO SCRUB THE SODA NOZZLES WITH SOAP AND WATER, RINSE WITH CLEAN WATER, AND SANITIZE BEFORE AIR DRYING AND RE-CONNECTING. ENSURE CORRECTION TODAY.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed soda syrup and Magnesol stored directly on the floor in the kitchen areas.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO ENSURE ALL FOOD IS STORED AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) DIGITAL THERMOMETER ON THE CVAP HOT HOLDING UNIT DOES NOT WORK.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO PROVIDE A THERMOMETER INSIDE THE HOT HOLDING UNIT BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the mop sink under constant pressure and an unapproved type of splitter on the mop sink faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS HAD THE MANAGER TAKE A PICTURE OF THE PROPER PRESSURE BLEED VALVE THAT IS REQUIRED. MANAGER WILL ORDER THE PIECE TODAY AND REMOVE THE UNAPPROVED SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK TODAY. PLEASE SEND PROOF OF THE PRESSURE BLEED VALVE BEING INSTALLED ONCE RECEIVED.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Receptacles, Provided for Paper Towel Disposal
violations.observation: There is no refuse container at the area immediately adjacent to both kitchen area hand sinks.
violations.corrective_action: If disposable paper towels are used at handwashing sinks, a trash can shall be located at each sink or group of adjacent sinks. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO PROVIDE SMALL TRASH CANS UNDER EACH HAND SINK BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO TRAIN STAFF TO HANG MOPS UP AFTER USE TO ALLOW AIR DRYING.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed some gaps/holes in the kitchen ceiling panels where electrical wiring, plumbing, or conduit lines are located.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS SHOWED THE MANAGER SOME OF THE GAPS/HOLES THAT NEED TO BE SEALED UP BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION.
